description: Quick-reference index for debugging. Route to specific KB file based on error type.
usage: 1. Match HTTP status to kb_file, 2. Read that file, 3. Follow P0 steps first, then P1, then P2

400.first_check: Compare frontend payload field names vs backend serializer

401.first_check: Check token sending in Authorization header

403.first_check: Search for exact error message text

404.first_check: Search for URL path in backend urls.py

500.first_check: Go to exact file:line from stack trace

universal_rules: NEVER edit code without reading it first
NEVER assume - verify by reading actual code
Trace backwards from error to root cause
Check P0 patterns before P1 before P2

django_quick_facts.onetoone_reverse: getattr() doesn't catch DoesNotExist - use try-except
